mapper.update: UPDATE import_job_attempts SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE import_job_attempts SET status = 'PARTIAL', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE import_job_attempts SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND job_id IN ( SELECT id FROM import_jobs WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= #{now}) )
